question: 확인 가능한 미국 물가·국채 금리와 KRW 환율은 각각 어떤 상태이며, 관측·공개·판본의 한계는 무엇인가?

series.name: 미국 headline CPI-U 원지수 (NSA)
series.definition: All items CPI-U, U.S. city average, 1982–84=100; not seasonally adjusted. Monthly label is the reference month, not the release date.
series.release_characteristics: Monthly, typically released in the following month; date varies. Current release is cross-checked against retained official excerpts.
series.revision_characteristics: Full release/revision history absent from v1 API. Current fetched version is not a historical first release; missing October 2025 remains explicit.

series.name: 미국 국채 2년 명목 시장금리
series.definition: 2-year constant-maturity Treasury yield, quoted on investment basis, annual percent; not policy rate, real yield or realized bond return. CSV Currency NA means no currency amount; underlying Treasury exposure is USD.
series.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
series.release_characteristics: U.S. business-day observation; publication lag and weekends differ from observation date.
series.revision_characteristics: Current H.15 CSV may include corrections; complete first-release/vintage history unavailable.

series.name: 미국 국채 10년 명목 시장금리
series.definition: 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield, quoted on investment basis, annual percent; not policy rate, real yield or realized bond return. CSV Currency NA means no currency amount; underlying Treasury exposure is USD.
series.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
series.release_characteristics: U.S. business-day observation; publication lag and weekends differ from observation date.
series.revision_characteristics: Current H.15 CSV may include corrections; complete first-release/vintage history unavailable.

series.name: 원/달러 뉴욕 정오 기준환율
series.definition: South Korean won per U.S. dollar; noon New York buying/reference rate. An increase means more KRW per USD, not a domestic executed FX rate or a realized foreign-asset return.
series.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
series.release_characteristics: Daily observations normally published in a weekly H.10 release; no invented weekend or not-yet-released daily value.
series.revision_characteristics: Current country CSV can incorporate subsequent corrections; an official August 2026 correction notice exists, but full row revision timestamps/history are unavailable.
